verses.he: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְנֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא־יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּעַמָּֽיו׃
verses.on: וַאֲמַר יְיָ לְמֹשֶׁה אֱמַר לְכַהֲנַיָא בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹן וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן עַל מִית לָא יִסְתָּאַב בְּעַמֵהּ
verses.en: Adonoy said to Moshe; speak, to the kohanim, the sons of Aharon, and you shall say to them, let him not defile himself with the dead among his people.

oe.t: Adonoy said to Moshe; speak, to the kohanim, the sons of Aharon, and you shall say to them, let him not defile himself with the dead among his people.

verses.he: כִּ֚י אִם־לִשְׁאֵר֔וֹ הַקָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑יו לְאִמּ֣וֹ וּלְאָבִ֔יו וְלִבְנ֥וֹ וּלְבִתּ֖וֹ וּלְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.on: אֱלָהֵן לְקָרִיבֵהּ דְקָרִיב לֵהּ לְאִמֵהּ וְלַאֲבוּהִי וְלִבְרֵהּ וְלִבְרַתֵּהּ וְלַאֲחוּהִי
verses.en: Except to his kin to whom he is closely related, for his mother and his father, for his son, his daughter and for his brother.

oe.t: Except to his kin to whom he is closely related, for his mother and his father, for his son, his daughter and for his brother.

verses.he: וְלַאֲחֹת֤וֹ הַבְּתוּלָה֙ הַקְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־הָיְתָ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ לָ֖הּ יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.on: וְלַאֲחָתֵהּ בְּתֻלְתָּא דְקָרִיבָא לֵהּ דִי לָא הֲוַת לִגְבַר לַהּ יִסְתָּאָב
verses.en: For his virgin sister, to whom he is closely related, who has not yet been married, for her, he may be defiled.

oe.t: For his virgin sister, to whom he is closely related, who has not yet been married, for her, he may be defiled.

verses.he: לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּ֖א בַּ֣עַל בְּעַמָּ֑יו לְהֵ֖חַלּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: לָא יִסְתָּאַב רַבָּא בְעַמֵהּ לְאַחֲלוּתֵהּ
verses.en: A husband may not defile himself among his people [for a wife through whom] he becomes profaned.

oe.t: An honored one among his people
] may not defile himself among his people [for a wife through whom] he becomes profaned.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יקרחה [יִקְרְח֤וּ] קָרְחָה֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֔ם וּפְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּבִ֨בְשָׂרָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת׃
verses.on: לָא יִמְרְטוּן מְרַט בְּרֵישְׁהוֹן וּפָאתָא דְדִקְנְהוֹן לָא יְגַלְחוּן וּבְבִשְׂרְהוֹן לָא יְחַבְּלוּן חִבּוּל
verses.en: They shall not make baldness on their heads and the corners of their beards they shall not shave, and they shall not make gashes in their flesh.

oe.t: They shall not make baldness on their heads and the corners of their beards they shall not shave, and they shall not make gashes in their flesh.

verses.he: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְהָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.on: קַדִישִׁין יְהוֹן קֳדָם אֱלָהֲהוֹן וְלָא יְחַלוּן שְׁמָא דֶאֱלָהֲהוֹן אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבָּנַיָא דַיְיָ קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֲהוֹן אִנוּן מַקְרִיבִין וִיהוֹן קַדִישִׁין
verses.en: They shall be holy to their God and they shall not profane the Name of their God, for [it is] the fire-offerings of Adonoy, the bread of their God [that] they bring [offer], and they must [therefore] be holy.

oe.t: ] their God and they shall not profane the Name of their God, for [it is] the fire-offerings [
] of their God [that] they bring [offer], and they must [therefore] be holy.

verses.he: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַחֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְאִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵאִישָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי־קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵאלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.on: אִתְּתָא מַטְעֲיָא וּמְחַלְלָא לָא יִסְבוּן וְאִתְּתָא דִמְתָרְכָא מִבַּעְלַהּ לָא יִסְבוּן אֲרֵי קַדִישׁ הוּא קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ
verses.en: A harlot or a profaned woman they shall not marry. A woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry, for he is holy to his God.

oe.t: ] or a profaned woman they shall not marry. A woman divorced from her husband they shall not marry, for he is holy to [

verses.he: וְקִדַּשְׁתּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֔ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וּתְקַדְשִׁנֵהּ אֲרֵי יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהָךְ הוּא מְקָרֵב קַדִישׁ יְהֵא לָךְ אֲרֵי קַדִישׁ אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִשְׁכוֹן
verses.en: You shall make him holy for he offers the bread of your God; he shall be holy unto you for I, Adonoy, am holy, Who makes you holy.

oe.t: You shall make him holy for he offers the bread [
] of your God; he shall be holy unto you for I, Adonoy, am holy, Who makes you holy.

verses.he: וּבַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִזְנ֑וֹת אֶת־אָבִ֙יהָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃ (ס)
verses.on: וּבַת גְבַר כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תִתְחַל לְמִטְעֵי מִקְדֻשַׁת אֲבוּהָ הִיא מִתַּחֲלָא בְּנוּרָא תִּתּוֹקָד
verses.en: The daughter of a kohein, who profanes herself by fornication—she profanes her father— she shall be burned with fire.

oe.t: The daughter of a kohein, who profanes herself by fornication [
she becomes profane with respect to her father’s holiness
] she shall be burned with fire.

verses.he: וְהַכֹּהֵן֩ הַגָּד֨וֹל מֵאֶחָ֜יו אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־יוּצַ֥ק עַל־רֹאשׁ֣וֹ ׀ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ וּמִלֵּ֣א אֶת־יָד֔וֹ לִלְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת־רֹאשׁוֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּבְגָדָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם׃
verses.on: וְכַהֲנָא דְאִתְרַבָּא מֵאֲחוֹהִי דְיִתָּרִיק עַל רֵישֵׁהּ מִשְׁחָא דִרְבוּתָא וְדִי קָרִיב יָת קֻרְבָּנֵהּ לְמִלְבָּשׁ יָת לְבוּשַׁיָא יָת רֵישֵׁהּ לָא יְרַבֵּי פֵרוּעַ וּלְבוּשׁוֹהִי לָא יִבְזַע
verses.en: The kohein who is greatest among his brethren upon whose head was poured the anointing oil; whose hands were consecrated to put on the special garments; shall not let his hair grow wild and he shall not tear his garments.

oe.t: The kohein who is greatest among his brethren upon whose head was poured the anointing oil [
] to put on the special garments; shall not let his hair grow wild and he shall not tear his garments.

verses.he: וְעַ֛ל כָּל־נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְאָבִ֥יו וּלְאִמּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא׃
verses.on: וְעַל כָּל נַפְשַׁת מֵתָא לָא יֵיעוֹל לַאֲבוּהִי וּלְאִמֵהּ לָא יִסְתָּאָב
verses.en: And adjacent to any dead body he shall not enter. For his father and mother he shall not become [ritually] impure.

oe.t: And adjacent to any dead body he shall not enter. For his father and mother he shall not become [ritually] impure.

verses.he: וּמִן־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְלֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑יו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛יו עָלָ֖יו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וּמִן מַקְדְשָׁא לָא יִפּוֹק וְלָא יַחֵל יָת מַקְדְשָׁא דֶאֱלָהֵהּ אֲרֵי כְּלִיל מְשַׁח רְבוּתָא דֶאֱלָהֵהּ עֲלוֹהִי אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: He shall not depart from the Sanctuary and he shall not profane his Gods Sanctuary, for the crown of his Gods anointing oil is upon him, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: He shall not depart from the Sanctuary and he shall not profane his Gods Sanctuary, for the crown of his Gods anointing oil [
] is upon him, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִבְתוּלֶ֖יהָ יִקָּֽח׃
verses.on: וְהוּא אִתְּתָא בִבְתֻלְתָּהָא יִסָב
verses.en: He shall marry [only] a virgin.

verses.he: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּגְרוּשָׁה֙ וַחֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם־בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵעַמָּ֖יו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.on: אַרְמְלָא וּמְתָרְכָא וְחַלִילָא מַטְעֲיָא יָת אִלֵין לָא יִסָב אֱלָהֵין בְּתֻלְתָּא מֵעַמֵהּ יִסַב אִתְּתָא
verses.en: A widow, divorcee, profaned woman or harlot; he may not marry [any] of these. But only a virgin from his own people may he marry.

oe.t: A widow, divorcee, profaned woman or harlot [
]; he may not marry [any] of these. But only a virgin from his own people may he marry.

verses.he: וְלֹֽא־יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖וֹ בְּעַמָּ֑יו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְלָא יַחֵל זַרְעֵהּ בְּעַמֵהּ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדְשֵׁהּ
verses.en: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Adonoy, who makes him holy.

oe.t: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Adonoy, who makes him holy.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֞ לְדֹרֹתָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בוֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְהַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.on: מַלֵל עִם אַהֲרֹן לְמֵימָר גְבַר מִבְּנָיִךְ לְדָרֵיהוֹן דִי יְהֵּי בֵהּ מוּמָא לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ
verses.en: Speak to Aharon saying; Anyone of your offspring, through [all] their generations who will have a blemish, shall not approach to offer the bread of his God.

oe.t: Speak to Aharon saying; Anyone of your offspring, through [all] their generations who will have a blemish, shall not approach to offer the bread [

verses.he: כִּ֥י כָל־אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ׃
verses.on: אֲרֵי כָל גְבַר דִּי בֵהּ מוּמָא לָא יִקְרַב גְבַר עַוִיר אוֹ חֲגִיר אוֹ חָרִים אוֹ שָׂרִיע
verses.en: For any man who has a blemish shall not approach; a blind man or a lame man, or a man with a sunken nose, or a man who has disproportionate limbs.

oe.t: For any man who has a blemish shall not approach; a blind man or a lame man, or a man with a sunken nose, or a man who has disproportionate limbs.

verses.he: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד׃
verses.on: אוֹ גְבַר דִי יְהֵי בֵהּ תְּבַר רַגְלָא אוֹ תְּבַר יְדָא
verses.en: or a man who has a broken (crippled) foot, or a broken (crippled) hand,

oe.t: or a man who has a broken (crippled) foot, or a broken (crippled) hand,

verses.he: אֽוֹ־גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ־דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּעֵינ֑וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.on: אוֹ גְבִין אוֹ דֻקָא אוֹ חִלִיז בְּעֵינֵהּ אוֹ גַרְבָן אוֹ חֲזָזָן אוֹ מְרִיס פַּחֲדִין
verses.en: or one with overhanging eyebrows, or with a cataract, or a disarrangement [in the eye], or one with scurf or scabs, or one with crushed testicles.

oe.t: or one with overhanging eyebrows, or with a cataract, or a disarrangement [in the eye], or one with scurf or scabs, or one with crushed testicles.

verses.he: כָּל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־בּ֣וֹ מ֗וּם מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְהַקְרִ֖יב אֶת־אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְהַקְרִֽיב׃
verses.on: כָּל גְבַר דִי בֵהּ מוּמָא מִזַרְעָא דְאַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא יָת קֻרְבָּנַיָא דַיְיָ מוּמָא בֵהּ יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֵהּ לָא יִקְרַב לְקָרָבָא
verses.en: Any man who has a blemish, who is a descendant of Aharon the kohein, shall not approach to offer the fire-offerings of Adonoy. He has a blemish; the bread of his God he may not approach to offer [as an offering].

oe.t: Any man who has a blemish, who is a descendant of Aharon the kohein, shall not approach to offer the fire-offerings [
] of Adonoy. He has a blemish; the bread [
] of his God he may not approach to offer [as an offering].

verses.he: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִקָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּמִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.on: קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֵהּ מִקֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשַׁיָא וּמִן קוּדְשַׁיָא יֵיכוּל
verses.en: The bread of his God which is of the most holy, and from the holy [offerings] he may eat.

oe.t: The bread of his God which is of the most holy, and from the holy [offerings] he may eat.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ אֶל־הַפָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְאֶל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי־מ֣וּם בּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת־מִקְדָּשַׁ֔י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.on: בְּרַם לְפָרֻכְתָּא לָא יֵיעוֹל וּלְמַדְבְּחָא לָא יִקְרַב אֲרֵי מוּמָא בֵהּ וְלָא יַחֵל יָת מַקְדְשַׁי אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִשְׁהוֹן
verses.en: However, he may not enter beyond the Curtain and he shall not approach the Altar for he has a blemish and he shall not profane My holy things, for I am Adonoy, who sanctifies them.

oe.t: However, he may not enter beyond the Curtain and he shall not approach the Altar for he has a blemish and he shall not profane My holy things, for I am Adonoy, who sanctifies them.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (פ)
verses.on: וּמַלִיל מֹשֶׁה עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְעִם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: Moshe spoke [these words] to Aharon, and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel.

oe.t: Moshe spoke [these words] to Aharon, and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְיִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִקָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: מַלֵיל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְיִפָּרְשׁוּן מִקוּדְשַׁיָא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלָא יְחַלוּן יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשִׁי דִי אִנוּן מְקַדְשִׁין קֳדָמַי אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and let them keep away from the holy offerings of Bnei Yisroel and they shall not profane My holy name which they sanctify for Me, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and let them keep away from the holy offerings of Bnei Yisroel and they shall not profane My holy name which they sanctify for [

verses.he: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם לְדֹרֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ ׀ אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרַ֣ב מִכָּל־זַרְעֲכֶ֗ם אֶל־הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וְטֻמְאָת֖וֹ עָלָ֑יו וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַהִ֛וא מִלְּפָנַ֖י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: אֱמַר לְהוֹן לְדָרֵיכוֹן כָּל גְבַר דִי יִקְרַב מִכָּל בְּנֵיכוֹן לְקוּדְשַׁיָא דִי יְקַדְשׁוּן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם יְיָ וְסֹאבְתֵיהּ עֲלוֹהִי וְיִשְׁתֵּיצֵי אֲנָשָׁא הַהִיא מִן קֳדָמַי אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: Say to them; throughout your generations; any person of your offspring who will draw near to the holy things which Bnei Yisroel will sanctify to Adonoy [while] his impurity is on him that soul shall be cut off from My Presence, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: Say to them; throughout your generations; any person of your offspring who will draw near to the holy things which Bnei Yisroel will sanctify to [
] Adonoy [while] his impurity is on him that soul [
] shall be cut off from My Presence, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִזֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְה֤וּא צָר֙וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב בַּקֳּדָשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א יֹאכַ֔ל עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְהַנֹּגֵ֙עַ֙ בְּכָל־טְמֵא־נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖נּוּ שִׁכְבַת־זָֽרַע׃
verses.on: גְבַר גְבַר מִזַרְעָא דְאַהֲרֹן וְהוּא סְגִיר אוֹ דָאִיב בְּקוּדְשַׁיָא לָא יֵיכוּל עַד דִי יִדְכֵּי וּדְיִקְרַב בְּכָל טְמֵא נַפְשָׁא אוֹ גְבַר דִי תִפּוֹק מִנֵהּ שִׁכְבַת זַרְעָא
verses.en: Any man of Aharons offspring; who has tzoraas or an impure flow, may not eat of the sacred things until he has purified himself. [The same is true] of anyone who touches anything defiled by the dead, or anyone who has had a seminal emission,

oe.t: Any man of Aharons offspring; who has tzoraas [
] or an impure flow, may not eat of the sacred things until he has purified himself. [The same is true] of anyone who touches anything defiled by the dead [
], or anyone who has had a seminal emission,

verses.he: אוֹ־אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּכָל־שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֑וֹ א֤וֹ בְאָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא־ל֔וֹ לְכֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: אוֹ גְבַר דִי יִקְרַב בְּכָל רִחֲשָׁא דִי יִסְתָּאַב לֵהּ אוֹ בַאֲנָשָׁא דִי יִסְתָּאַב לֵהּ לְכָל סֹאבְתֵיהּ
verses.en: or anyone who touches any creeping creature that causes impurity to him, or any person which causes impurity to him, [with] whatever impurity he has.

oe.t: or anyone who touches any creeping creature that causes impurity to him, or any person which causes impurity to him, [with] whatever impurity he has.

verses.he: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע־בּ֔וֹ וְטָמְאָ֖ה עַד־הָעָ֑רֶב וְלֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם־רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.on: אֱנַשׁ דִי יִקְרַב בֵּהּ וִיהֵי מְסָאָב עַד רַמְשָׁא וְלָא יֵיכוּל מִן קוּדְשַׁיָא אֱלָהֵן אַסְחֵי בִשׂרֵהּ בְּמַיָא
verses.en: Anyone touching [that person] will be impure until the evening. He shall not eat of the holy things unless he has washed his body in water.

oe.t: Anyone touching [that person] will be impure until the evening. He shall not eat of the holy things unless he has washed his body in water.

verses.he: וּבָ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְטָהֵ֑ר וְאַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן־הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י לַחְמ֖וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.on: וּבְמֵעַל שִׁמְשָׁא וְיִדְכֵּי וּבָתַר כֵּן יֵיכוּל מִן קוּדְשַׁיָא אֲרֵי לַחְמֵהּ הוּא
verses.en: When the sun sets, he is pure, and afterwards, he may eat of the holy things, for it is his bread.

oe.t: When the sun sets, he is pure, and afterwards, he may eat of the holy things, for it is his bread.

verses.he: נְבֵלָ֧ה וּטְרֵפָ֛ה לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל לְטָמְאָה־בָ֑הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: נְבִילָא וּתְבִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל לְאִסְתָּאָבָא בָהּ אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: An animal which has died on its own, or an animal that was fatally maimed, he must not eat to defile himself with it, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: An animal which has died on its own, or an animal that was fatally maimed, he must not eat to defile himself with it, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י וְלֹֽא־יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָיו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּמֵ֥תוּ ב֖וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃
verses.on: וְיִטְרוּן יָת מַטְּרַת מֵימְרִי וְלָא יְקַבְּלוּן עֲלוֹהִי חוֹבָא וִימוּתוּן בֵּהּ אֲרֵי יְחַלֻנֵהּ אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִשְׁהוֹן
verses.en: They shall keep my charge lest they bear [the burden] of sin and die because of it for having profaned [it]. I am Adonoy Who makes them holy.

oe.t: ] lest they bear [the burden] of sin and die because of it for having profaned [it]. I am Adonoy Who makes them holy.

verses.he: וְכָל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.on: וְכָל חִלוֹנַי לָא יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא תּוֹתָבָא דְכַהֲנָא וַאֲגִירָא לָא יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא
verses.en: No stranger (non-kohein) may eat holy things. One indentured to a kohein and one hired [by a kohein] may not eat sacred-offerings.

oe.t: No stranger (non-kohein) may eat holy things. One indentured to a kohein and one hired [by a kohein] may not eat sacred-offerings.

verses.he: וְכֹהֵ֗ן כִּֽי־יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑וֹ וִילִ֣יד בֵּית֔וֹ הֵ֖ם יֹאכְל֥וּ בְלַחְמֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְכָהֵן אֲרֵי יִקְנֵי נְפַשׁ קִנְיַן כַּסְפֵּהּ הוּא יֵיכוּל בֵּהּ וִילִיד בֵּיתֵהּ אִנוּן יֵיכְלוּן בְּלַחְמֵהּ
verses.en: If a kohein shall purchase a person [as a slave, that person is] his monetary possession. He may eat of it, and the [slave] born in his house, they may eat of his bread.

oe.t: If a kohein shall purchase a person [as a slave, that person is] his monetary possession. He may eat of it, and the [slave] born in his house, they may eat of his bread.

verses.he: וּבַת־כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה לְאִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא בִּתְרוּמַ֥ת הַקֳּדָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.on: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהִי לִגְבַר חִלוֹנָי הִיא בְּאַפְרָשׁוּת קוּדְשַׁיָא לָא תֵיכוּל
verses.en: When a koheins daughter marries a non-kohein, the sacred terumah portions may not be eaten by her.

oe.t: When a koheins daughter marries a non-kohein, the sacred terumah [
] portions may not be eaten by her.

verses.he: וּבַת־כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּגְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְזֶרַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָהּ֒ וְשָׁבָ֞ה אֶל־בֵּ֤ית אָבִ֙יהָ֙ כִּנְעוּרֶ֔יהָ מִלֶּ֥חֶם אָבִ֖יהָ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְכָל־זָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃ (ס)
verses.on: וּבַת כָּהֵן אֲרֵי תְהֵי אַרְמְלָא וּמְתָרְכָא וּבַר לֵית לַהּ וּתְתוּב לְבֵית אֲבוּהָא כְּרַבְיוּתָהָא מִלַחְמָא דַאֲבוּהָא תֵּיכוּל וְכָל חִלוֹנַי לָא יֵיכוּל בֵּהּ
verses.en: If a koheins daughter is either widowed or divorced, and she has no children, and she returns to her fathers home as in her youth, she may eat of her fathers bread. No non-kohein may eat of it.

oe.t: If a koheins daughter is either widowed or divorced, and she has no children, and she returns to her fathers home as in her youth, she may eat of her fathers bread. No non-kohein may eat of it.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְיָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁיתוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנָתַ֥ן לַכֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יֵיכוּל קוּדְשָׁא בְּשָׁלוּ וְיוֹסֵף חוּמְשֵׁהּ עֲלוֹהִי וְיִתֵּן לְכַהֲנָא יָת קוּדְשָׁא
verses.en: If a man inadvertently eats of sacred-offering, he shall add a fifth, to it[s worth] and give to the kohein the holy thing.

oe.t: If a man inadvertently eats of sacred-offering, he shall add a fifth, to it[s worth] and give to the kohein the holy thing.

verses.he: וְלֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת־קָדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יָרִ֖ימוּ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וְלָא יְחַלוּן יָת קוּדְשַׁיָא דִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת דִי יַפְרְשׁוּן קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: They shall not profane the holy things of Bnei Yisroel that which they designated for Adonoy.

oe.t: They shall not profane the holy things of Bnei Yisroel that which they designated for [

verses.he: וְהִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה בְּאָכְלָ֖ם אֶת־קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃ (פ)
verses.on: וִיקַבְּלוּן עֲלֵיהוֹן עֲוָיָן וְחוֹבִין בְּמֵיכָלְהוֹן בְּסוֹאֲבָא יָת קוּדְשֵׁיהוֹן אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִשְׁהוֹן
verses.en: They burden them[selves] with the sin of their guilt when they eat their holy things, for I am Adonoy, Who makes them holy.

oe.t: They burden them[selves] with the sin of their guilt when they eat their holy things [
], for I am Adonoy, Who makes them holy.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־בָּנָ֗יו וְאֶל֙ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּמִן־הַגֵּ֣ר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנוֹ֙ לְכָל־נִדְרֵיהֶם֙ וּלְכָל־נִדְבוֹתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַיהוָ֖ה לְעֹלָֽה׃
verses.on: מַלֵל עִם אַהֲרֹן וְעִם בְּנוֹהִי וְעִם כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן גְבַר גְבַר מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן גִיוֹרָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל דִי יְקָרֵב קֻרְבָּנֵהּ לְכָל נִדְרֵיהוֹן וּלְכָל נִדְבָתְהוֹן דִי יְקָרְבוּן קֳדָם יְיָ לַעֲלָתָא
verses.en: Speak to Aharon and to his sons and to all of Bnei Yisroel and say to them; any man of the House of Israel, and from the proselytes of Israel who will bring his offering for any of their vows or for any of their free-will-offerings that they will bring to Adonoy, for a burnt-offering.

verses.he: לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֑ם תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּבָּקָ֕ר בַּכְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּבָֽעִזִּֽים׃
verses.on: לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן שְׁלִים דְכוּרָא בְּתוֹרֵי בְּאִמְרַיָא וּבְעִזַיָא
verses.en: To gain acceptance [it must be] an unblemished male of cattle, sheep or goats.

oe.t: To gain acceptance [it must be] an unblemished male of cattle, sheep or goats.

verses.he: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־בּ֥וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א לְרָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.on: כֹּל דִי בֵהּ מוּמָא לָא תְקָרְבוּן אֲרֵי לָא לְרַעֲוָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן
verses.en: Anything that has a blemish on it you shall not bring, for it will not be accepted favorably for you.

oe.t: Anything that has a blemish on it you shall not bring, for it will not be accepted favorably for you.

verses.he: וְאִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח־שְׁלָמִים֙ לַיהוָ֔ה לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֙דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִנְדָבָ֔ה בַּבָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַצֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְרָצ֔וֹן כָּל־מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יְקָרֵב נִכְסַת קוּדְשַׁיָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְפָרָשָׁא נִדְרָא אוֹ לִנְדַבְתָּא בְּתוֹרֵי אוֹ בְעָנָא שְׁלִים יְהֵי לְרַעֲוָא כָּל מוּמָא לָא יְהֵי בֵהּ
verses.en: If a man will bring a peace-offering to Adonoy, to fulfill an articulated vow or free-will-offering of cattle or of sheep, it shall be unblemished, that it be favorably accepted. No blemish shall be in it.

oe.t: If a man will bring a peace[
] Adonoy, to fulfill an articulated vow or free-will-offering of cattle or of sheep, it shall be unblemished, that it be favorably accepted. No blemish shall be in it.

verses.he: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ־חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ־יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא־תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַיהוָ֑ה וְאִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵהֶ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: עַוִיר אוֹ תְבִיר אוֹ פְסִיק אוֹ יַבְּלָן אוֹ גַרְבָן אוֹ חֲזָזָן לָא תְקָרְבוּן אִלֵין קֳדָם יְיָ וְקֻרְבָּנָא לָא תִתְּנוּן מִנְהוֹן עַל מַדְבְּחָא קֳדָם יְיָ

verses.he: וְשׁ֥וֹר וָשֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְקָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וּלְנֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה׃
verses.on: וְתוֹר וְאִמַר יַתִּיר וְחַסִיר נְדַבְתָּא תַּעְבֵּד יָתֵהּ וּלְנִדְרָא לָא יְהֵי לְרַעֲוָא
verses.en: An ox or lamb with one limb larger [or smaller] than the other or with uncleft hooves, you shall make (offer) it as a free-will-offering [to the temple treasury] [but] for [the fulfillment of] a vow it will not be favorably accepted.

verses.he: וּמָע֤וּךְ וְכָתוּת֙ וְנָת֣וּק וְכָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּֽבְאַרְצְכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.on: וְדִי מְרִיס וְדִי רְסִיס וְדִי שְׁלִיף וְדִי גְזִיר לָא תְקָרְבוּן קֳדָם יְיָ וּבְאַרְעֲכוֹן לָא תַעְבְּדוּן
verses.en: [An animal that has its testicles] crushed, mangled, torn or cut off you shall not bring to Adonoy and in your land you shall not inflict these injuries.

oe.t: [An animal that has its testicles] crushed, mangled, torn or cut off you shall not bring to [
] Adonoy and in your land you shall not inflict these injuries.

verses.he: וּמִיַּ֣ד בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת־לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤ם בָּהֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃ (פ)
verses.on: וּמִן בַּר עַמְמִין לָא תְקַרְבוּן יָת קֻרְבַּן אֱלָהֲכוֹן מִכָּל אִלֵין אֲרֵי חִבּוּלְהוֹן בְּהוֹן מוּמָא בְהוֹן לָא לְרַעֲוָא יְהוֹן לְכוֹן
verses.en: And from a strangers [gentiles] hand you shall not bring (offer) the bread of your God from any of these for they have inflicted wounds in them; they will not be favorably accepted for you.

oe.t: And from a strangers [gentiles] hand you shall not bring (offer) the bread [

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ־כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ־עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְהָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑וֹ וּמִיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ וָהָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְקָרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: תּוֹר אוֹ אִמָר אוֹ עִזָא אֲרֵי יִתְיְלִיד וִיהֵי שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין בָּתַר אִמֵהּ וּמִיוֹמָא תְמִינָאָה וּלְהַלָא יִתִּרְעִי לְקָרָבָא קֻרְבָּנָא קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: An ox, lamb or goat, when it is born, shall be with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day and thereafter it may be favorably accepted as a sacrifice as a fire-offering to Adonoy.

oe.t: An ox, lamb or goat, when it is born, shall be with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day and thereafter it may be favorably accepted as a sacrifice as a fire-offering to [

verses.he: וְשׁ֖וֹר אוֹ־שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣וֹ וְאֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.on: וְתוֹרְתָּא אוֹ שֵׂיתָא לֵהּ וְלִבְרֵהּ לָא תִכְּסוּן בְּיוֹמָא חָד
verses.en: An ox or a lamb, it and its offspring, you shall not slaughter in one day.

oe.t: ] offspring, you shall not slaughter in one day.

verses.he: וְכִֽי־תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח־תּוֹדָ֖ה לַיהוָ֑ה לִֽרְצֹנְכֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ׃
verses.on: וַאֲרֵי תִּכְּסוּן נִכְסַת תּוֹדְתָא קֳדָם יְיָ לְרַעֲוָא לְכוֹן תִּכְּסֻנֵהּ
verses.en: When you sacrifice a thanks-giving-offering to Adonoy, that it be favorably accepted for you you shall sacrifice it.

oe.t: When you sacrifice a thanks-giving-offering to [
] Adonoy, that it be favorably accepted for you you shall sacrifice it.

verses.he: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: בְּיוֹמָא הַהוּא יִתְאֲכֵל לָא תַשְׁאֲרוּן מִנֵהּ עַד צַפְרָא אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: On that day [that it is sacrificed] you should eat it; you shall leave none of it until the next morning, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: On that day [that it is sacrificed] you should eat it; you shall leave none of it until the next morning, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וְתִטְרוּן פִּקוּדַי וְתַעֲבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: You shall preserve My commandments and fulfill them, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall preserve My commandments and fulfill them, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וְלֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֔י וְנִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.on: וְלָא תְחַלְלוּן יָת שְׁמָא דְקוּדְשַׁי וְאִתְקַדַשׁ בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲנָא יְיָ מְקַדִשְּׁכוֹן
verses.en: You shall not profane My holy Name; but I will be sanctified among Bnei Yisroel. I am Adonoy Who makes you holy.

oe.t: You shall not profane My holy Name; but I will be sanctified among Bnei Yisroel. I am Adonoy Who makes you holy.

verses.he: הַמּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ (פ)
verses.on: דְאַפִּיק יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם לְמֶהֱוֵי לְכוֹן לֵאלָהָא אֲנָא יְיָ
verses.en: Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God, I am Adonoy.

oe.t: Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God, I am Adonoy.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.he: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽי׃

verses.on: שִׁתָּא יוֹמִין תִּתְעֲבֵד עִבִידָא וּבְיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה שְׁבַת שְׁבָתָא מְעָרַע קַדִישׁ כָּל עִבִידָא לָא תַעֲבְּדוּן שַׁבְּתָא הִיא קֳדָם יְיָ בְּכֹל מוֹתְבָנֵיכוֹן
verses.en: Six days shall work be performed; and on the seventh day is a Shabbos of resting, a holy assembly. You shall not do any work, it is a Shabbos for Adonoy in all your dwelling places.

]. You shall not do any work, it is a Shabbos for [

verses.on: וְתִסְבוּן לְכוֹן בְּיוֹמָא קַדְמָאָה פֵּרֵי אִילָנָא אֶתְרוֹגִין וְלֻלָבִין וַהֲדַסִין וְעַרְבִין דִנְחָל וְתֶחֱדוּן קֳדָם יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין
verses.en: You shall take for yourselves, on the first day, the fruit of the beautiful tree (esrog), a branch of palm trees (lulav), boughs of thick-leaved trees (hadasim), and willows of the brook (aravos), and you shall rejoice before Adonoy, your God, for seven days.

oe.t: You shall take for yourselves, on the first day, the fruit of the beautiful tree (esrog) [
], boughs of thick-leaved trees (hadasim), and willows of the brook (aravos), and you shall rejoice before Adonoy, your God, for seven days.

verses.he: וְחַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּתְחַגוּן יָתֵהּ חַגָא קֳדָם יְיָ שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין בְּשַׁתָּא קְיַם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה תְּחַגוּן יָתֵהּ
verses.en: You shall celebrate it as a festival to Adonoy seven days in the year; it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations in the seventh month, you shall celebrate it.

oe.t: You shall celebrate it as a festival to [
] Adonoy seven days in the year; it is an everlasting statute throughout your generations in the seventh month, you shall celebrate it.

verses.he: בַּסֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל־הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּסֻּכֹּֽת׃
verses.on: בִּמְטַלַיָא תֵיתְבוּן שַׁבְעַת יוֹמִין כָּל יַצִיבָא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל יֵתְבוּן בִּמְטַלַיָא
verses.en: You shall dwell in the sukkos seven days, every native born Israelite shall dwell in the sukkos.

oe.t: ] sukkos seven days, every native born [

verses.he: לְמַעַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַסֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּהוֹצִיאִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: בְּדִיל דְיִדְעוּן דָרֵיכוֹן אֲרֵי בִמְטַלָיוּת עֲנָנֵי אוֹתֵבִית יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאַפָּקוּתִי יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרַיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן
verses.en: So that your generations will know that in the sukkos I caused Bnei Yisroel to dwell when I took them out from the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: So that your generations will know that in the [
] sukkos I caused Bnei Yisroel to dwell when I took them out from the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (פ)
verses.on: וּמַלִיל מֹשֶׁה יָת סְדַר מוֹעֲדַיָא דַיְיָ וְאַלֵפִנוּן לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: And thus Moshe declared the appointed times of Adonoy to Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: צַ֞ו אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.on: פַּקֵד יָת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִסְבוּן לָךְ מְשַׁח זֵיתָא דַכְיָא כָּתִישָׁא לְאַנְהָרָא לְאַדְלָקָא בוֹצִינַיָא תְּדִירָא
verses.en: Command Bnei Yisroel to take (bring) to you pure, pressed, olive oil for illumination to keep the lamp burning constantly.

oe.t: Command Bnei Yisroel to take (bring) to you pure, pressed, olive oil for illumination to keep the lamp [

verses.he: מִחוּץ֩ לְפָרֹ֨כֶת הָעֵדֻ֜ת בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵעֶ֧רֶב עַד־בֹּ֛קֶר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: מִבָּרָא לְפָרֻכְתָּא דְסַהֲדוּתָא בְּמַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא יַסְדַר יָתֵהּ אַהֲרֹן מֵרַמְשָׁא עַד צַפְרָא קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא קְיָם עָלָם לְדָרֵיכוֹן
verses.en: Outside of the Curtain of the Testimony, which is inside the Tent of Meeting, Aharon shall arrange it [so that it burns] from evening until morning before Adonoy, continually; as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

oe.t: Outside of the Curtain of the Testimony, which is inside the Tent of Meeting, Aharon shall arrange it [so that it burns] from evening until morning before Adonoy, continually; as an everlasting statute throughout your generations.

verses.he: עַ֚ל הַמְּנֹרָ֣ה הַטְּהֹרָ֔ה יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת־הַנֵּר֑וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃ (פ)
verses.on: עַל מְנַרְתָּא דָכִיתָא יַסְדַר יָת בּוֹצִינַיָא קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא
verses.en: Atop the pure menorah he shall arrange the lights before Adonoy, constantly.

oe.t: Atop the pure menorah he shall arrange the lights before Adonoy, constantly.

verses.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְאָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֖ה הַֽחַלָּ֥ה הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.on: וְתִסַב סֻלְתָּא וְתֵיפֵי יָתַהּ תַּרְתָּא עַשְׂרֵי גְרִיצָן תְּרֵין עֶשְׂרוֹנִין תְּהֵי גְרִצְתָּא חֲדָא
verses.en: You shall take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, each individual loaf shall be two tenths [of an ephah].

oe.t: You shall take fine flour and bake twelve loaves, each individual loaf shall be two tenths [of an ephah].

verses.he: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַטָּהֹ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וּתְשַׁוִי יָתְהוֹן תַּרְתֵּי סִדְרִין שִׁית סִדְרָא עַל פָּתוֹרָא דַכְיָא קֳדָם יְיָ
verses.en: You shall place them in two stacks, six in each stack on the Pure Table, before Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall place them in two stacks, six in each stack on the Pure Table, before Adonoy.

verses.he: וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֤ה לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ לְאַזְכָּרָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.on: וְתִתֵּן עַל סִדְרָא לְבֹנְתָּא דָכִיתָא וּתְהֵי לִלְחֵם לְאִדְכַּרְתָּא קֻרְבָּנָא קָדָם יְיָ
verses.en: You shall put pure frankincense on [each] stack and it shall be as a memorial portion for the bread, as a fire-offering, to Adonoy.

oe.t: You shall put pure frankincense on [each] stack and it shall be as a memorial portion for the bread, as a fire-offering, to [

verses.he: בְּי֨וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛נּוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵאֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.on: בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא בְּיוֹמָא דְשַׁבְּתָא יַסְדְרִנֵהּ קֳדָם יְיָ תְּדִירָא מִן קֳדָם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל קְיַם עָלָם
verses.en: On each and every Shabbos he shall arrange them before Adonoy, continually, from Bnei Yisroel as an eternal covenant.

oe.t: On each and every Shabbos he shall arrange them before Adonoy, continually, from [
] Bnei Yisroel as an eternal covenant.

verses.he: וְהָֽיְתָה֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּלְבָנָ֔יו וַאֲכָלֻ֖הוּ בְּמָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ כִּ֡י קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ מֵאִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק־עוֹלָֽם׃ (ס)
verses.on: וּתְהֵי לְאַהֲרֹן וְלִבְנוֹהִי וְיֵכְלֻנֵהּ בַּאֲתַר קַדִישׁ אֲרֵי קֹדֶשׁ קוּדְשִׁין הוּא לֵהּ מִקֻרְבָּנַיָא דַיְיָ קְיַם עָלָם
verses.en: It shall belong to Aharon and to his sons and they shall eat it in a sacred place, for it is most holy for him from among the fire-offerings of Adonoy, as an everlasting statute.

oe.t: It shall belong to Aharon and to his sons and they shall eat it in a sacred place, for it is most holy for him from among the fire-offerings [
] of Adonoy, as an everlasting statute.

verses.he: וַיֵּצֵא֙ בֶּן־אִשָּׁ֣ה יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְהוּא֙ בֶּן־אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְאִ֖ישׁ הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי׃
verses.on: וּנְפַק בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהוּא בַּר גְבַר מִצְרָאָה בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּנְצוֹ בְּמַשְׁרִיתָא בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגַבְרָא בַּר יִשְׂרָאֵל
verses.en: The son of an Israelite woman went out, and he was the son of an Egyptian man, among Bnei Yisroel. They argued in the encampment—the son of the Israelite woman, and the Israelite man.

oe.t: The son of an Israelite woman went out, and he was the son of an Egyptian man, among Bnei Yisroel. They argued in the encampment—the son of the Israelite woman, and the Israelite man.

verses.he: וַ֠יִּקֹּב בֶּן־הָֽאִשָּׁ֨ה הַיִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית אֶת־הַשֵּׁם֙ וַיְקַלֵּ֔ל וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְשֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֛וֹ שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת־דִּבְרִ֖י לְמַטֵּה־דָֽן׃
verses.on: וּפָרֵשׁ בַּר אִתְּתָא בַת יִשְׂרָאֵל יָת שְׁמָא וְאַרְגֵז וְאַיְתִיאוּ יָתֵהּ לְוָת מֹשֶׁה וְשׁוּם אִמֵהּ שְׁלֹמִית בַּת דִבְרִי לְשִׁבְטָא דְדָן
verses.en: The Israelite womans son clearly pronounced the Name [of God] and blasphemed and they brought him to Moshe. The name of his mother was Shlomis, daughter of Divri of the tribe of Dan.

oe.t: The Israelite womans son clearly pronounced the Name [of God] and blasphemed [
] and they brought him to Moshe. The name of his mother was Shlomis, daughter of Divri of the tribe of Dan.

verses.he: וַיַּנִּיחֻ֖הוּ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר לִפְרֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ (פ)
verses.on: וְאַסְרוֹהִי בְּבֵית מַטְרָא עַד דְיִתְפָּרַשׁ לְהוֹן עַל גְזֵרַת מֵימְרָא דַיְיָ
verses.en: They placed him in the guardhouse until [his penalty] would be explained to them through the word of Adonoy.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.on: וּמַלִיל יְיָ עִם מֹשֶׁה לְמֵימָר
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe, saying;

verses.he: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְסָמְכ֧וּ כָֽל־הַשֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְרָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃
verses.on: אַפֵּק יָת דְאַרְגֵז לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְּׁרִיתָא וְיִסְמְכוּן כָּל דִי שְׁמָעוּ יָת יְדֵיהוֹן עַל רֵישֵׁהּ וְיִרְגְמוּן יָתֵהּ כָּל כְּנִשְּׁתָּא
verses.en: Take the blasphemer beyond the encampment, and all those who heard him shall lay their hands on his head and the entire congregation shall stone him.

oe.t: ] beyond the encampment, and all those who heard him shall lay their hands on his head and the entire congregation shall stone him.

verses.he: וְאֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי־יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖יו וְנָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וְעִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּמַלֵל לְמֵימָר גְבַר גְבַר דִי יַרְגֵז קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ וִיקַבֵּל חוֹבֵהּ
verses.en: And to Bnei Yisroel you shall speak, saying; Any person who shall blaspheme his God shall bear [the burden of] his sin.

oe.t: And to Bnei Yisroel you shall speak, saying; Any person who shall blaspheme [
] his God shall bear [the burden of] his sin.

verses.he: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ב֖וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָ֑ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנָקְבוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.on: וְדִי פָרֵשׁ שְׁמָא דַיְיָ אִתְקְטָּלָא יִתְקְטֵל מִרְגַם יִרְגְמוּן בֵּהּ כָּל כְּנִשְׁתָּא כְּגִיוֹרָא כְּיַצִיבָא בְּפָרָשׁוּתֵהּ שְׁמָא יִתְקְטֵל
verses.en: Whoever pronounces clearly the Name of Adonoy [and blasphemes] he will surely be put to death. The entire congregation shall surely stone him. The proselyte and native born alike when he clearly articulates the Name, shall be put to death.

oe.t: Whoever pronounces clearly the Name of Adonoy [and blasphemes] he will surely be put to death. The entire congregation shall surely stone him. The proselyte and native born [
] alike when he clearly articulates the Name, shall be put to death.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִקְטוֹל כָּל נַפְשָׁא דַאֲנָשָׁא אִתְקְטָלָא יִתְקְטֵל
verses.en: Any man who kills any human being must surely be put to death.

oe.t: Any man who kills any human being must surely be put to death.

verses.he: וּמַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.on: וּדְיִקְטוֹל נְפַשׁ בְּעִירָא יְשַׁלְמִנַהּ נַפְשָׁא חֳלַף נַפְשָׁא
verses.en: Whoever kills an animal shall pay for it, [the compensation of] an animal for an animal.

oe.t: Whoever kills an animal shall pay for it, [the compensation of] an animal for an animal.

verses.he: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יִתֵּן מוּמָא בְּחַבְרֵהּ כְּמָא דִי עֲבַד כֵּן יִתְעֲבֵד לֵיהּ
verses.en: A man who maims his neighbor just as he did, so shall be done to him.

oe.t: A man who maims his neighbor just as he did, so shall be done to him.

verses.he: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃
verses.on: תַּבְרָא חֳלַף תַּבְרָא עֵינָא חֳלַף עֵינָא שִׁנָא חֳלַף שִׁנָא כְּמָא דִי יִתֵּן מוּמָא בַּאֲנָשָׁא כֵּן יִתְיְהֵב בֵּהּ
verses.en: [Compensation for] a broken bone [in exchange] for a broken bone, [compen-sation for] the loss of an eye [in exchange] for the loss of an eye, [compensation for] the loss to a tooth [in exchange] for the loss of a tooth; just as he maimed the man, so shall it be done to him [monetarily].

oe.t: [Compensation for] a broken bone [in exchange] for a broken bone, [compen-sation for] the loss of an eye [in exchange] for the loss of an eye, [compensation for] the loss to a tooth [in exchange] for the loss of a tooth; just as he maimed the man, so shall it be done to him [monetarily].

verses.he: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃
verses.on: וּדְיִקְטוֹל בְּעִירָא יְשַׁלְמִנַהּ וּדְיִקְטוֹל אֲנָשָׁא יִתְקְטֵל
verses.en: Whoever smites an animal shall pay for it. Whoever smites a person shall be put to death.

oe.t: ] an animal shall pay for it. Whoever smites [
] a person shall be put to death.

verses.he: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.on: דִינָא חֲדָא יְהֵי לְכוֹן כְּגִיוֹרָא כְּיַצִיבָא יְהֵי אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהֲכוֹן
verses.en: One rule shall apply for all of you just as it is for the proselyte, so it shall be for the native born, for I am Adonoy, your God.

oe.t: One rule shall apply for all of you just as it is for the proselyte, so it shall be for the native born [
], for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ (פ)
verses.on: וּמַלִיל מֹשֶׁה עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַפִּיקוּ יָת דְאַרְגֵז לְמִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא וּרְגָמוּ יָתֵהּ אַבְנָא וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדוּ כְּמָא דִי פַּקֵיד יְיָ יָת מֹשֶׁה
verses.en: Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel and they took the blasphemer, beyond the encampment and they stoned him with a stone. And Bnei Yisroel did just as Adonoy commanded Moshe.

oe.t: Moshe spoke to Bnei Yisroel and they took the blasphemer [
], beyond the encampment and they stoned him with a stone. And Bnei Yisroel did just as Adonoy commanded Moshe.
